question: Five students- 1, 2, 3 ,4 and 5- are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 4 is sitting to the immediate right of 1 and immediate left of 2. 5 is sitting second to the left of 1. Which of the following statements is true?

options.text: 5 is sitting third to the right of 3.
